the_change: Bucket set becomes {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128}. The scheme's economics are unchanged where it matters: at T=128/R=128 the padded tile count is E*ceil(128/128) = 64 against ~64 real tiles (~1.0x), while rows read 8x — the same rows-vs-tiles split the original registration required reporting.
